integrity: Results depend on independent unit-jump Poisson subordinators and a common independent positive Mittag-Leffler time; the Gaussian covariance trace is summable. All limiting statements are proved analytically; exact finite checker output is secondary evidence.
limitations: Whole multipole absence only; the logarithmic Poisson profile is selected to exhibit a critical scale. The boundary Dickman limit is known and not asserted as novel. No generalization to dependent subordinator components or strong sparsity is claimed.
title: Quenched spectral-hole phases and annealed logarithmic sparsity in compound-Poisson grey spherical fields
